title: Pure Elfnote
summary: Elfnote cards plus the Medius the Pure package that fetches Elfnote Power Patron, paired with generic staples. The Elfnote monsters rotate through the center Main Monster Zone to search, recruit from the Deck, place Continuous Spells and Traps, and Quick-Synchro Summon during either turn.

summary.title: Starters
points: Elfnote Lucina Special Summons itself to the center Main Monster Zone and searches another Elfnote monster from the Deck.
Elfnote Regina sends another Elfnote card to Special Summon itself on either turn, and while in the center zone it Special Summons an Elfnote directly from the Deck.

Medius the Pure adds or Special Summons Elfnote Power Patron from the Deck on Summon, while Theorealize Past Lull summons Medius from the hand or Deck without allowing an opponent response while you control an Elfnote card.

summary.title: Opening: Elfnote Lucina + Medius the Pure
steps: Special Summon Elfnote Lucina to the center Main Monster Zone and search Elfnote Regina (or Elfnote Tinia).
Normal Summon Medius the Pure to Special Summon Elfnote Power Patron from the Deck, triggering Theorealized Medius from the hand to search Theorealize Overdrive.
Use Elfnote Regina or Elfnote Tinia to rotate the center zone, placing Elfnotes: Welcome Home face-up to send a monster and summon another Elfnote of a different Attribute from the Deck.

During either turn, use Elfnote Power Patron's Quick Effect to raise the center monster's Level by 3 and immediately Synchro Summon Elfnote Seraphim Strelitzia, Elfnote June Pride, or Junora the Power Patron of Tuning.

summary.title: Center Zone Rotation
summary.text: Every Main Deck Elfnote gains bonus effects in or moving into the center Main Monster Zone. On the opponent's turn, Elfnote Lucina swaps into the center zone to bounce a monster, Elfnote Fortuna places an Elfnote Continuous Trap and swaps in to bounce a Spell or Trap, and Limited Elfnote Tinia places an Elfnote Continuous Spell and swaps in to banish a card from the opponent's hand. Junoldo the Shadespirit Power Patron counts as an Elfnote card, draws 2 cards from the Pendulum Zone when an Elfnote arrives, and banishes the top 3 cards of your Deck to summon Junora.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Elfnote June Pride (Level 10 Synchro) restricts attacks so only center-zone monsters can attack while it occupies the center, and returns itself to Special Summon up to 3 Elfnotes (one each from the hand, Deck, and GY).
Elfnote Seraphim Strelitzia (Level 7 Synchro) Special Summons a Level 6 or lower Elfnote and reduces the Levels of all Level 4 or higher monsters by 3 to disrupt opposing Xyz and Synchro plays.
Junora the Power Patron of Tuning (Level 10 Synchro) negates the effects of every face-up card the opponent currently controls upon Synchro Summon.
Note: Elfnote Power Patron and Elfnotes: Welcome Home lock your Extra Deck into Synchro Monsters, so the Extra Deck prioritizes Elfnote Synchros.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Elfnotes: Welcome Home protects your center monster from destruction and sends a monster to Special Summon a different-Attribute Elfnote from the Deck; Elfnotes: A Plea for Help grants targeting immunity to the center monster with bonus Attribute effects.
Theorealize Overdrive revives Medius the Pure from the GY and banishes itself from the GY to set a monster's Level from 1 to 10 for exact Synchro tuning.

Elfnotes: Rhapsodia of Madness forces attacks into the center monster and revives a different-Attribute Elfnote, Elfnotes: Aristeia of Trust shifts monster zones and negates a Spell or Trap with three Elfnotes out, and Elfnotes: Quatrain of Succession prevents center-zone banishment while converting a Spell/Trap into a Level 1-4 Tuner Token.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's multi-engine combo lines include the generic Power Patron Link Monsters, which conflict with the Synchro-only Extra Deck lock on Elfnote Power Patron and Elfnotes: Welcome Home.

main: Elfnote Lucina
Special Summons itself to the center zone and searches another Elfnote; on the opponent's turn, swaps into the center to bounce a monster.
Elfnote Regina
Newest Main Deck Elfnote. Sends another Elfnote to summon itself on either turn; in the center zone, summons an Elfnote from the Deck.
Elfnote Fortuna
Special Summons itself to the center zone and places an Elfnote Continuous Trap; on the opponent's turn, swaps in to bounce a Spell/Trap.
Elfnote Tinia
Limited. Special Summons itself to the center zone and places an Elfnote Continuous Spell; swaps in to banish a card from the opponent's hand.
Elfnote Power Patron
Quick Effect: raises the center monster's Level by 3 and Synchro Summons an Elfnote or Junora at once; used as material, searches an Elfnote card. Synchro-only Extra Deck while it's out.
Medius the Pure
Summoned: adds or summons Elfnote Power Patron; revives itself from the GY.
Junoldo the Shadespirit Power Patron
Counts as Elfnote: banishes the top three cards to bring out Junora; in the Pendulum Zone, draws two when an Elfnote arrives.
Theorealized Medius
Newest support. Special Summons itself while a Power Patron card is out and searches a Theorealize card.
Elfnotes: Welcome Home
Protects the center monster from destruction, and sends a monster to summon an Elfnote of a different Attribute from the Deck.
Elfnotes: A Plea for Help
Protects the center monster from targeting, with extra effects by its Attribute.
Theorealize Past Lull
With an Elfnote card out, summons Medius the Pure and the opponent can't respond.
Theorealize Overdrive
Revives Medius the Pure; from the GY, sets a monster's Level from 1 to 10.
Elfnotes: Rhapsodia of Madness
Forces attacks into the center monster, and sends a monster to revive an Elfnote of another Attribute.
Elfnotes: Aristeia of Trust
Moves your monsters between zones, and negates a Spell/Trap with three Elfnotes out.
Elfnotes: Quatrain of Succession
Stops the center monster being banished, and turns a Spell/Trap into a Tuner token of any Level from 1 to 4.
extra: Level 10: in the center zone only center monsters can attack, and it returns to summon an Elfnote each from the hand, Deck and GY.
Level 7: summons a Level 6 or lower Elfnote and lowers every Level 4+ monster by 3.
Junora the Power Patron of Tuning
Level 10: Synchro Summoned, negates every opposing face-up card.
